method: Read exact source, parse Python AST without importing/executing helpers, compare generated receipt structures with accepted Prep C6 and Backup C3 collectors. No mocked or real helper execution.

findings.summary: Composer creates integration acceptance without checking the accepted integration evidence.
findings.evidence: The generated receipt sets verdict pass and both runtimeIntegrationAccepted/uiIntegrationAccepted true. No runtime/UI/integration review or root acceptance receipt is loaded; provenance lists only supplied observation/CI/backup/rehearsal/owner files. Accepted v2 validator expects precisely these generated booleans, so body consistency cannot supply missing approval provenance.
findings.repair: Require exact accepted runtime/UI/integration review and closure pins, verify their candidate and scope, and bind the output head to actual reviewed publication provenance before generating derived integration receipt.

findings.summary: Composer promotes incompletely validated source observations into stronger schema/identity/synthetic/permission assertions.
findings.evidence: Source profiles are unchecked. DB source schema/readOnly/synthetic flags, provider project/autodeploy/readiness profile and exact environment/service, and owner verification booleans are not all validated before hardcoding schema21/paused/synthetic/membership claims. CI only checks six successful rows, not exact names/PR6/freshness. Output sidecar hashes prove which bytes were supplied, not that the derived assertions follow from them.
findings.repair: Validate exact known receipt profiles, fixed target identity, exact schema and immutable accepted collector pins, required true flags and canonical fresh timestamps; validate exact six unique required names and reviewed PR/head. Preserve genuine timestamps and reject contradictory input before exclusive output writes.
findings.downstream_boundary: Accepted v2 validator independently refuses malformed check names/stale timestamps and mismatching backup/rehearsal bodies. It cannot recover source facts or approval evidence omitted by composition.

findings.summary: Observer executes the stop-helper dependency before checking its reviewed hash.
findings.evidence: spec.loader.exec_module(s) runs on line4; digest assertion runs on line5 using the already-loaded module. A changed dependency is executed before refusal.
findings.repair: Hash the dependency bytes with local standard-library code and compare the accepted digest before importing it.

safe_mechanics_observed: Fixed base and branch, empty initial index, workspace-relative non-private paths, exact file hash verification.
Exclusive fsynced intent and pathspec precede staging; exact staged set and staged bytes checked.
Commit parent/content checks and remote-head equality; receipt explicitly records required checks pending.
publication_disposition.remaining_authority_boundary: The current helper only checks bytes of manifest.reviews; an empty list or arbitrary review file is not rejected. It does not verify review verdict/reviewer or bind reviewed file set to the manifest. Publication requires a separately accepted exact manifest with verified execution-time hash, or a concrete canonical manifest-review check in the helper. No inventory acceptance is issued here.
publication_disposition.ci_boundary: Publishing records checks pending. Six fresh exact-head checks remain a separate gate before maintenance.

receipt_compatibility_observed: Generated target/admission receipts omit their own pins when written, matching v2 expected receipt structure.
Backup receipt fields copied except profile/projectRef match accepted Backup C3 body shape; v2 later checks exact content.
Restore/preservation/migration completion equality and actual backup receipt hash checked.

DB input shape must be Backup C3 preflight/inspection with applicationStateSha256 plus table inventory; accepted stage collector uses currentApplicationStateSha256 and omits table-name list, so it is not interchangeable.
limits: Static review only; no helper import/run, subprocess, network, credentials, Git, provider, DB or actual publication.
No signed-in IDs, private receipt contents or secrets copied into this report.
Final publication manifest absent; final inventory and exact reviewed manifest digest remain unreviewed.
